title: Carbon Rim Appearance & Customization

seo.title: Carbon Rim Finishes: UD, Paintless & Laser Logos
seo.description: Explore UD carbon rim finishes, paintless surfaces and laser logos, with custom lead times, 260°C brake track heat resistance and surface treatment choices.
seo.imageAlt: Laser engraving a logo on a carbon fiber rim

intro: Our current focus is UD carbon, paintless surfaces, and laser-engraved logos. Carbon patterns, surface finishes, and logos can be combined. Other appearances are available by custom order and require additional production time.

ud.name: UD (Unidirectional)
ud.description: A simple unidirectional carbon pattern, and the main rim appearance we currently offer.

paintless.name: Paintless Surface
paintless.description: Retains the carbon surface without an additional painting process. This is our main surface finish.

laserLogo.name: Laser-Engraved Logos
laserLogo.description: Our main method for adding logos and lettering. Logo engraving serves a different purpose from laser treatment of a brake track.

customizationLeadTime: Other carbon patterns, painted finishes, gloss levels, and crystal effects are still available by custom order, with longer production times than our main options. Confirm availability and the additional time for your rim model and design before ordering.

brakeTracks.resinDescription: We use an optimized high-temperature resin system. The heat-resistance specification for the brake track as a whole is 260°C.
brakeTracks.standardTitle: Standard Brake Track with an Optimized Surface
brakeTracks.standardDescription: We recommend the standard appearance with its already optimized surface as the first choice for a brake track. The specific surface depends on the selected rim model.
brakeTracks.laserBenefit: Laser treatment and other surface treatments are available for the brake track. Laser treatment increases surface friction.
brakeTracks.laserTradeoff: Laser treatment also affects the outer carbon fiber layer. Although these configurations have been tested, testing does not make them a perfect solution. Consider this tradeoff before choosing.

laser.body: Laser engraving is our main method for adding logos and lettering, and can be combined with UD carbon and a paintless surface. Traditional decals, painted graphics, and other options are available by custom order with additional production time.

bullets.0: Creates the logo on the rim surface without applying a separate decal.
bullets.1: Confirm the artwork, placement, and desired appearance before ordering.
bullets.2: Other logo methods remain available by custom order; confirm the additional production time separately.

laser.guideNote: This video shows logo engraving. For the friction benefit and carbon surface tradeoff of laser-treated brake tracks, see the brake track section above.
laser.videoAlt: Carbon rim logo laser engraving process video

selectionAdvice.title: Choosing Your Appearance

items.0: For our main appearance options, consider UD carbon with a paintless surface and laser-engraved logos.
items.1: For other patterns, colors, or logo methods, confirm the design in advance and allow additional production time.
items.2: For rim-brake rims, we recommend the standard brake track with its optimized surface. If choosing laser treatment, consider both the friction benefit and the effect on the outer carbon fiber layer.

selectionAdvice.footer: For OEM, team, or branding orders, contact us to confirm the rim model, logo artwork, appearance requirements, and lead time.
